headline: Singapore High Court Orders Foodcourt Operator Singapura Heritage to Wind Up
summary: Singapore High Court ordered foodcourt operator Singapura Heritage Food Hall, which is linked to the Lao Huo Tang restaurant group, to wind up.
why: Corporate insolvencies in the food and beverage sector reflect pressures from operating costs and consumer spending shifts in local markets.

impacts.name: Singapura Heritage Food Hall
impacts.why: The company was ordered by the High Court to wind up.
